mapping.preserved: Default 1.60 mm sheet and four 4.50 mm long tray sockets derived directly from measured sheet and socket loops; original low carrier web topology informs connected breakaway card.
mapping.proposedFit: 4.50 × (sheet+fit) mm socket, (4.50−fit) × sheet tongue; fit0.10–0.30mm TOTAL allowance. Four adhesive seats, no calibrated press-fit claim. Rod gaps0.3–0.7mm separate from fixed seat fits.
mapping.newStructure: Seven parts: shaped signature tray, two upright two-tongue fences, four lift-out Napier rods. Each rod has an actual header digit and nine diagonal two-digit product cells. Four chosen digits0–9 drive all36 cells. Numerical cuts are original3×5 bitmap glyphs with0.48mm strokes and0.4mm depth. Rod length10×rowPitch; corridor4×rodWidth+5×rodGap. Fences leave open ends and top for insertion, reordering and removal.
mapping.carrier: Two-row seven-bay carrier, 28 accessible bed-aligned runners, four per piece away from interfaces. New0.8–1.4mm widths and0.4–0.6mm heights, deliberately thicker than source0.21–0.22mm webs. CSG unioned, not loose print-plate pieces.
mapping.personalization: Exact image-derived sampled relief or strict supported imported STL Boolean-subtracted in radius6.5mm tray tag at y−12. Backing≥1mm; no rod or socket interference. No raw source mesh distributed.
mapping.reusedInfrastructure: Reusable editor, image sampler, strict file parser, local icons, saved design format, worker shell, Three viewer, serializer and test harness adapted from preceding Daily Object Lab studio; all Napier kit geometry, arithmetic, assembly poses, carrier packing and collision/numeral tests new for this run.
mapping.validation: Computational checks only: float32 mesh/winding/manifold/bounds,28 cuts, assembly insertion and rod gaps, no-overlap, support footprint, diagonal arithmetic,2850 engraved bit probes. Physical printing, legibility, assembly and adhesive strength untested.
